name: vuena
description: A scalable, modular ERP template built with Vue 3, Framework7, PowerSync, and Capacitor. Features offline-first architecture, real-time sync, and mobile-first design. Includes example modules and comprehensive developer tools.

scripts.run:android:staging: run-p build:staging && run-p trapeze:staging && npx cap run android
scripts.run:android:prod: run-p build:prod && run-p trapeze:prod && npx cap run android
scripts.run:android:dev: run-p build:dev && run-p trapeze:dev && npx cap run android
scripts.run:ios:staging: run-p build:staging && run-p trapeze:staging && npx cap run ios
scripts.run:ios:prod: run-p build:prod && run-p trapeze:prod && npx cap run ios
scripts.run:ios:dev: run-p build:dev && run-p trapeze:dev && npx cap run ios
scripts.deploy:android:staging: run-p build:staging && run-p trapeze:staging && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd app/build/outputs/apk/debug/ && echo Opening folder... && powershell -Command "explorer ." && cd ../../../../../..
scripts.deploy:android:prod: run-p build:prod && run-p trapeze:prod && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease && cd app/build/outputs/apk/release/ && (start . || open . || xdg-open .) && cd ../../../../../..
scripts.deploy:android:dev: run-p build:dev && run-p trapeze:dev && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd app/build/outputs/apk/debug/ && (start . || open . || xdg-open .) && cd ../../../../../..
scripts.deploy:ios:staging: run-p build:staging && run-p trapeze:staging && npx cap sync ios && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace Vuena.xcworkspace -scheme Vuena -configuration Debug -sdk iphoneos -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15 Pro Max' build && cd ../.. && npx cap open ios
scripts.deploy:ios:prod: run-p build:prod && run-p trapeze:prod && npx cap sync ios && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace Vuena.xcworkspace -scheme Vuena -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15 Pro Max' build && cd ../.. && npx cap open ios
scripts.deploy:ios:dev: run-p build:dev && run-p trapeze:dev && npx cap sync ios && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace Vuena.xcworkspace -scheme Vuena -configuration Debug -sdk iphoneos -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15 Pro Max' build && cd ../.. && npx cap open ios
